title: Getting your first licence without running out of cash
target: How to open up new products without wrecking the shop's cash flow, using the licence, level and credit behaviour the game defines.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop that already sells something
An idea of your daily takings

steps.do: Unlock the licence before you order the stock it covers.
steps.because: licences are their own objects, separate from ordering (ProductLicenseSOs)

steps.do: Check the store level a product needs before planning around it.
steps.because: a product can carry a required store level (RequiredStoreLevel)

steps.do: Keep the licence purchase inside money you already have rather than borrowing for it first.
steps.because: borrowing is a tracked state with repayments of its own (BankCreditSO, LoanStatus, LoanPaymentsTab)

steps.do: Price the new line before it reaches the shelf.
steps.because: prices are set through the shop's bulk pricing rather than per shelf item (BulkPricingManager)

commonMistakes: Ordering stock for a product the shop level has not unlocked.
Borrowing for a licence and then missing a repayment.
Shelving a new product with no price on it.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
